page.overview:
What is My Friend of Misery?

My Friend of Misery is the eleventh track off of Metallica's fifth studio album The Black Album. The song was written by James Hetfield, Lars Ulrich, and Jason Newsted.

The track is about an outsider's view of someone wandering in self-pity and having a very pessimistic view of the rest of the world.
